data.name: SyncBatchNotFound
data.value: The sync batch was not found.

data.name: SyncBatchIdentityConflict
data.value: The client batch identifier was already used with different content. Send the corrections in a new batch.

data.name: SyncBatchRecordIdentityConflict
data.value: A client record identifier in the batch was already used for different data.

data.name: SyncBatchConcurrentChange
data.value: The batch changed concurrently. Retry with the same client batch identifier.

data.name: OperationAccepted
data.value: The request was accepted.

data.name: SubmitSyncBatchSummary
data.value: Submit an offline sync batch

data.name: SubmitSyncBatchDescription
data.value: Receives the readings and checkpoint passages captured offline by the assigned field guide. The batch and its accepted records are stored in one transaction; invalid records are returned in rejectedRecords with a code. Repeating the same batch returns the same result.

data.name: GetSyncBatchByIdSummary
data.value: Get a sync batch result

data.name: GetSyncBatchByIdDescription
data.value: Returns the persisted result of a sync batch of the current agency: accepted, duplicate and rejected record identifiers and the evaluation status.

data.name: SubmitSyncBatchSchema
data.value: Readings and checkpoint passages captured offline and sent together.

data.name: SyncBatchSchema
data.value: Persisted result of a sync batch.

data.name: InvalidCheckpointPassedAt
data.value: The passage time must be within the tracking session and not after its synchronization.

data.name: CheckpointPassageOutOfSequence
data.value: The previous checkpoint of the route has not been passed before this passage.

data.name: SyncBatchCheckpointArrivalRequired
data.value: Record a valid arrival at this checkpoint before synchronizing a batch there.

data.name: IncidentTransitionForbidden
data.value: Your role cannot execute this incident transition. The assigned field guide confirms or dismisses and only an operations administrator declares an emergency.

data.name: IncidentAlertOutsideSession
data.value: The early warning alert belongs to another tracking session or expedition group.

data.name: IncidentAlertDismissed
data.value: The early warning alert was dismissed and cannot originate an incident.

data.name: IncidentAlertAlreadyLinked
data.value: An incident was already reported from this early warning alert.

data.name: InvalidIncidentAlertId
data.value: The alert identifier must be a positive number.

data.name: IncidentTransitionNoteTooLong
data.value: The note cannot exceed 500 characters.

data.name: InvalidEvacuationActionRequest
data.value: The evacuation action data is invalid. The capture time cannot be in the future.

data.name: EvacuationActionForbidden
data.value: Only the assigned field guide records evacuation actions.

data.name: EvacuationRequiresEmergency
data.value: Evacuation actions are recorded only for a capture made while the emergency of the incident was declared.

data.name: EvacuationActionIdentityConflict
data.value: The client action identifier was already used with different content.

data.name: RequiredEvacuationClientActionId
data.value: A client action identifier is required.

data.name: RequiredEvacuationDescription
data.value: A description of up to 500 characters is required.

data.name: EvacuationLocationTooLong
data.value: The location cannot exceed 200 characters.

data.name: RequiredEvacuationStatus
data.value: A valid status is required: in_progress, completed or aborted.

data.name: RequiredEvacuationRecordedAt
data.value: The capture time is required.

data.name: IncidentNotificationForbidden
data.value: Only an operations administrator requests external communications.

data.name: IncidentNotificationRequiresEmergency
data.value: External communications require an incident with a declared emergency.

data.name: IncidentNotificationRecipientNotAllowed
data.value: The recipient is not an authorized staff address of the agency.

data.name: IncidentNotificationNotFound
data.value: The notification does not exist for this incident.

data.name: IncidentNotificationIdentityConflict
data.value: The notification identifier was already used with different content.

data.name: IncidentNotificationAttemptInProgress
data.value: Another attempt of this notification is in progress. Try again in a moment.

data.name: IncidentNotificationNotRetriable
data.value: Only a pending notification can be retried.

data.name: RequiredNotificationRecipientEmail
data.value: The recipient e-mail address is required.

data.name: ConfirmIncidentSummary
data.value: Confirm an incident

data.name: ConfirmIncidentDescription
data.value: The assigned field guide confirms a reported incident after verifying it in the field.

data.name: DismissIncidentSummary
data.value: Dismiss an incident

data.name: DismissIncidentDescription
data.value: The assigned field guide dismisses a reported incident as a false report. A dismissed incident admits no further transitions.

data.name: DeclareIncidentEmergencySummary
data.value: Declare an emergency

data.name: DeclareIncidentEmergencyDescription
data.value: An operations administrator declares an emergency for a confirmed incident. Evacuation actions and external communications require it.

data.name: CloseIncidentSummary
data.value: Close an incident

data.name: CloseIncidentDescription
data.value: Closes a resolved incident. A closed incident admits no further changes.

data.name: RecordEvacuationActionSummary
data.value: Record an evacuation action

data.name: RecordEvacuationActionDescription
data.value: Records an evacuation action captured by the assigned field guide, possibly offline. A retry with the same clientActionId and content returns the first record.

data.name: GetEvacuationActionsSummary
data.value: Get the evacuation actions of an incident

data.name: GetEvacuationActionsDescription
data.value: Returns the evacuation actions of an incident ordered by capture time.

data.name: GetIncidentNotificationByIdSummary
data.value: Get an incident notification

data.name: GetIncidentNotificationByIdDescription
data.value: Returns one notification of an incident by its identity.

data.name: RetryIncidentNotificationSummary
data.value: Retry a pending notification

data.name: RetryIncidentNotificationDescription
data.value: Retries a pending notification with the same identity and payload, for example after a timeout.

data.name: RefreshIncidentNotificationStatusSummary
data.value: Check the delivery state of a notification

data.name: RefreshIncidentNotificationStatusDescription
data.value: Asks the provider for the state of an accepted notification and stores a confirmed delivery or failure.

data.name: IncidentTransitionSchema
data.value: Optional note of an incident transition.

data.name: IncidentStatusChangeSchema
data.value: A recorded transition of an incident: previous and new state, actor, note and moment.

data.name: RecordEvacuationActionSchema
data.value: An evacuation action captured in the field, with its client identity and capture time.

data.name: EvacuationActionSchema
data.value: A persisted evacuation action with its capture and reception times.

data.name: FieldGuideCodeAlreadyExists
data.value: Another field guide of the agency already uses that operational code.

data.name: InvalidFieldGuideCode
data.value: The operational code must have 2 to 20 letters, digits or hyphens.

data.name: HealthNotesTooLong
data.value: The health information cannot exceed 500 characters.

data.name: RegisterHealthInformationSummary
data.value: Save my health information

data.name: RegisterHealthInformationDescription
data.value: The authenticated adventure tourist saves or clears optional health information for the expedition. Only the guide assigned to the group and the agency administrators read it; it is never included in summaries or notifications.

data.name: HealthInformationSchema
data.value: Optional health information shared by the participant, up to 500 characters.
